verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API to access the platform programmatically and export data, plus an official MCP server that lets external AI assistants search errors and analyze performance, so an external agent can query error and performance data to debug production. The evidence does not show agent-facing querying of logs or metrics specifically, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented API or MCP querying of logs, documented metrics query endpoints, explicit trace-query API reference, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production this way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically. You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
